                  "lineNumber": 9213,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\\n\\n## Key Security Features\\n\\n### Supabase (Data Layer)\\n\\n2. **Database Constraints**:\\n\\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\\n\\n### Next.js (Application Layer)\\n\\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\\n\\n   - Queries &amp;#96;profiles&amp;#96; table for linked user_id\\n   - Checks &amp;#96;removed_access&amp;#96; is null for active access\\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\\n\\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\\n\\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\\n\\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\\n\\n   - Admin sets &amp;#96;removed_access&amp;#96; timestamp and &amp;#96;removed_access_by&amp;#96; profile\\n   - Immediate effect on next request\\n  [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 9461,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"  .from('profiles')\","

        "contents": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Users table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)\n-- Note: Synced via Next.js server actions, not database triggers\ncreate table public.users (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  email text not null,\n  name text,\n  picture text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\n-- Role enum for profiles (authorization)\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\n-- Focus: Authentication and authorization only\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  removed_access timestamptz,  -- null = active, set = revoked\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\n-- Indexes for auth queries\ncreate index profiles_user_id_idx on public.profiles(user_id);\ncreate index profiles_work_email_idx on public.profiles(work_email);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Entity Relationships\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────┐       ┌─────────────────┐\n│   auth.users    │       │    profiles     │\n│  (Supabase)     │       │  (Auth only)    │\n├─────────────────┤       ├─────────────────┤\n│ id (uuid)       │◄──┐   │ id (uuid)       │\n│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │",

          },
          {
            "text": "create table public.users (",

          },
          {
            "text": "  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": ");",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Role enum for profiles (authorization)",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "create type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Focus: Authentication and authorization only",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "create table public.profiles (",

          {
            "text": "  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),",

          },
          {
            "text": "  name text not null,",

          },
          {
            "text": "  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification",

            "text": "  work_email text unique not null,",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',",

          },
          {
            "text": "  removed_access timestamptz,  -- null = active, set = revoked",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "  constraint valid_czu_domain check (",

          },

        "contents": "4. **School Email Verification** - Unverified users must:\n   - Enter their school email (@pef.czu.cz)\n   - System checks if email is in pre-registered list\n   - If valid, sends 6-digit verification code\n   - User enters code to complete verification\n5. **Access Granted** - Verified users access the dashboard\n\n## Database Schema\n\n### Tables\n\n#### &#96;profiles&#96;\nExtended user info linked to Supabase auth.users\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK, FK → auth.users.id) | No | Links to Supabase auth |\n| full_name | TEXT | No | User's display name |\n| role | ENUM ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin') | No | User role |\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | Yes | Assigned team (students/team leaders only) |\n| is_verified | BOOLEAN | No | School email verified? Default: false |\n| school_email | TEXT | Yes | Verified school email |\n| locale | TEXT | No | Preferred language ('cs', 'en'). Default: 'cs' |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Registration time |\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Last update time |\n\n#### &#96;teams&#96;\nTeam companies (tymove firmy)\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Team identifier |\n| name | TEXT | No | Team name |\n| year | INTEGER | No | Cohort year (1, 2, 3) |\n| is_active | BOOLEAN | No | Still active team? Default: true |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Creation time |\n\n#### &#96;pre_registered_emails&#96;\nAdmin-imported student list from Excel\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Record identifier |\n| email | TEXT (unique) | No | School email from Excel |\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | No | Assigned team |\n| role | ENUM | No | Expected role |\n| full_name | TEXT | Yes | Name from Excel (optional) |\n| claimed_by | UUID (FK → profiles.id) | Yes | User who claimed this email |\n| claimed_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | Yes | When claimed |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Import time |\n\n#### &#96;verification_codes&#96;",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./supabase/migrations/20260131161556_link_users_to_profiles.sql",

        },
        "contents": "comment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to link profiles when email changes\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\ndrop trigger if exists link_user_to_profile_trigger on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger link_user_to_profile_trigger\nafter update of email on auth.users\nfor each row\nwhen (old.email is distinct from new.email)\nexecute function public.link_user_to_profile();\n\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- INITIAL DATA LINKING\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Link existing profiles to users based on current email matches\n-- This handles any existing data that needs to be linked\n-- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences\nupdate public.profiles p\nset user_id = u.id\nfrom public.users u\ninner join auth.users au on u.auth_user_id = au.id\nwhere lower(trim(p.work_email)) = lower(trim(au.email))\n  and (p.user_id is null or p.user_id = u.id);\n\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership. Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification. Automatically linked when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- GRANTS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Grant execute permissions for the trigger function\ngrant execute on function public.link_user_to_profile() to authenticated;",

        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "-- Migration: Link users to profiles based on email matching\n-- Purpose: Automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email\n-- Affected tables: profiles, users, auth.users\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically when user email changes in auth.users table\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to link profiles to users based on email matching\n-- Matches auth.users.email with profiles.work_email and links via public.users\n-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table\ncreate or replace function public.link_user_to_profile()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_user_id uuid;\n  v_auth_email text;\nbegin\n  -- Get the email from auth.users (use NEW.email after update)\n  v_auth_email := new.email;\n  \n  -- Only proceed if email is not null and has changed\n  if v_auth_email is null or v_auth_email = '' then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id\n  select id into v_user_id\n  from public.users\n  where auth_user_id = new.id;\n  \n  -- If no matching public.users row found, return early\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Link profile to user if work_email matches auth.users.email\n  -- Only update if profile exists and is not already linked to a different user\n  -- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences\n  update public.profiles\n  set user_id = v_user_id\n  where lower(trim(work_email)) = lower(trim(v_auth_email))\n    and (user_id is null or user_id = v_user_id);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================",

        "contents": "CREATE INDEX idx_profiles_is_verified ON profiles(is_verified);\nCREATE INDEX idx_pre_registered_emails_email ON pre_registered_emails(email);\nCREATE INDEX idx_pre_registered_emails_claimed_by ON pre_registered_emails(claimed_by);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_user_id ON verification_codes(user_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_school_email ON verification_codes(school_email);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_expires_at ON verification_codes(expires_at);\n\n-- Function to handle new user signup\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n    INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, full_name, role, team_id, is_verified, locale, created_at, updated_at)\n    VALUES (\n        NEW.id,\n        COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'full_name', ''),\n        COALESCE((NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'role')::user_role, 'student'),\n        CASE \n            WHEN NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'team_id' IS NOT NULL \n            THEN (NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'team_id')::UUID \n            ELSE NULL \n        END,\n        FALSE,\n        COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'locale', 'cs'),\n        NOW(),\n        NOW()\n    );\n    RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n-- Trigger to create profile on user signup\nCREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created\n    AFTER INSERT ON auth.users\n    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user();\n\n-- Function to update updated_at timestamp\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n    NEW.updated_at = NOW();\n    RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;\n\n-- Trigger to auto-update updated_at on         "contents": "ALTER TABLE verification_codes ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\n\n-- Teams: Anyone authenticated can read active teams\nCREATE POLICY \"Anyone can view active teams\" ON teams\n    FOR SELECT USING (is_active = true);\n\n-- Teams: Only admins can modify teams\nCREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage teams\" ON teams\n    FOR ALL USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles \n            WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid() \n            AND profiles.role = 'admin'\n        )\n    );\n\n-- Profiles: Users can read their own profile\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can view own profile\" ON profiles\n    FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = id);\n\n-- Profiles: Verified users can view other profiles in their team\nCREATE POLICY \"Verified users can view team profiles\" ON profiles\n    FOR SELECT USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles AS viewer\n            WHERE viewer.id = auth.uid()\n            AND viewer.is_verified = true\n            AND (\n                viewer.team_id = profiles.team_id\n                OR viewer.role IN ('coach', 'admin')\n            )\n        )\n    );\n\n-- Profiles: Users can update their own profile\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can update own profile\" ON profiles\n    FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = id)\n    WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = id);\n\n-- Profiles: Admins can manage all profiles\nCREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage all profiles\" ON profiles\n    FOR ALL USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles \n            WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid() \n            AND profiles.role = 'admin'\n        )\n    );\n\n-- Pre-registered emails: Users can check if their email exists\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can check pre-registered emails\" ON pre_registered_emails\n    FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL);\n\n-- Pre-registered emails: Only admins can modify\nCREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage pre-registered emails\" ON pre_registered_emails\n    FOR ALL USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles ",

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasLinkedProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (authError || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Query profiles directly - RLS policy ensures user can only see their own profile\n  // The RLS policy checks: user_id in (select id from public.users where auth_user_id = auth.uid())\n  // This is more reliable than nested selects with RLS\n  const { data: profiles, error: queryError } = await supabaseClient\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"id\")\n    .limit(1);\n\n  // Return false if query failed or no profiles found\n  if (queryError || !profiles) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if at least one profile exists\n  return Array.isArray(profiles) &amp;&amp; profiles.length &gt; 0;\n}\n\n/**\n * Gets the current authenticated user's profile ID\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @returns The profile ID if found, null otherwise\n */",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "## Architecture Overview",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "flowchart TD",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "        G --&gt; E",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "        L --&gt; M",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "    end",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "    end",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "## Validation Flow",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "**Two-stage validation:**",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Client-side: Immediate feedback",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Checked on every request via middleware",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "Two tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",
            "lineNumber": 96
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.38415488600730896
    },

→ User logged in with Google but hasn't verified work email\n- **Pending Approval**: Work email verified via OTP, but no profile exists with that email\n- **Verified &amp; Active**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NOT NULL AND profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **Access Revoked**: &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NOT NULL&#96;\n\n## Constants\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// lib/constants/auth.ts\nexport const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [\n  'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\n};\n\n// Profile roles (matches database enum)\nexport const PROFILE_ROLES = ['student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin'] as const;\nexport type ProfileRole = typeof PROFILE_ROLES[number];\n\n// Role hierarchy for permission checks\nexport const ROLE_HIERARCHY: Record&lt;ProfileRole, number&gt; = {\n  student: 0,\n  team_leader: 1,\n  coach: 2,\n  admin: 3,\n} as const;\n\nexport const hasMinimumRole = (userRole: ProfileRole, requiredRole: ProfileRole): boolean =&gt; {\n  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] &gt;= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole];\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking",

        "contents": "export async function hasLinkedProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n\n}\n\n/**\n * Gets the current authenticated user's profile ID\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @returns The profile ID if found, null otherwise\n */\nexport async function getCurrentUserProfileId(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;string | null&gt; {\n  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (authError || !user) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Query profiles directly - RLS policy ensures user can only see their own profile\n  // The RLS policy checks: user_id in (select id from public.users where auth_user_id = auth.uid())\n  const { data: profiles, error: queryError } = await supabaseClient\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"id\")\n    .limit(1)\n    .single();\n\n  // Return null if query failed or no profile found\n  if (queryError || !profiles) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  return profiles.id;\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates an error URL with the given error message\n */\nexport function createErrorUrl(request: NextRequest, errorMessage: string): URL {\n  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        "contents": "-- Users can update their own user record\ncreate policy \"Users can update their own user record\" on public.users\nfor update\nto authenticated\nusing ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id )\nwith check ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id );\n\n-- Users can insert their own user record (during signup via trigger)\ncreate policy \"Users can insert their own user record\" on public.users\nfor insert\nto authenticated\nwith check ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id );\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- RLS POLICIES - PROFILES TABLE\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Users can view their own profile\ncreate policy \"Users can view their own profile\" on public.profiles\nfor select\nto authenticated\nusing (\n  user_id in (\n    select id\n    from public.users\n    where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())\n  )\n);\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- RLS POLICIES - REALTIME MESSAGES TABLE\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Users can receive broadcasts for their own user record\ncreate policy \"Users can receive broadcasts for their own user record\" on realtime.messages\nfor select\nto authenticated\nusing (\n  topic like 'users:%'\n  and exists (\n    select 1\n    from public.users\n    where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())\n    and topic = 'users:' || id::text\n  )\n);\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- GRANTS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Grant execute permissions for Supabase Auth hook function\n-- Trigger functions (handle_new_auth_user, validate_czu_email_domain_trigger) are invoked by triggers, not directly, so no EXECUTE grants needed\ngrant execute on function public.before_user_created_hook(jsonb) to supabase_auth_admin;\ngrant usage on schema public to supabase_auth_admin;\nrevoke execute on function public.before_user_created_hook(jsonb) from anon, authenticated, public;",

        "contents": "export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n    // Check if code matches\n    if (verificationCode.code !== code) {\n      // Increment attempts\n      await supabase\n        .from(\"verification_codes\")\n        .update({ attempts: verificationCode.attempts + 1 })\n        .eq(\"id\", verificationCode.id);\n\n      const remainingAttempts = MAX_ATTEMPTS - verificationCode.attempts - 1;\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        {\n          error: &#96;Neplatný kód. Zbývající pokusy: ${remainingAttempts}&#96;,\n        },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Code is valid! Mark as used\n    await supabase\n      .from(\"verification_codes\")\n      .update({ used: true })\n      .eq(\"id\", verificationCode.id);\n\n    // Get role and team from pre_registered_emails\n    const { data: preRegistered, error: preRegError } = await supabase\n      .from(\"pre_registered_emails\")\n      .select(\"role, team_id\")\n      .eq(\"email\", school_email.toLowerCase())\n      .single();\n\n    if (preRegError || !preRegistered) {\n      console.error(\"Failed to get pre_registered_emails:\", preRegError);\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nepodařilo se načíst data z registrace\" },\n        { status: 500 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Update profile: set is_verified, school_email, role, and team_id from pre_registered\n    const { error: profileError } = await supabase\n      .from(\"profiles\")\n      .update({\n        is_verified: true,\n        school_email: school_email.toLowerCase(),\n        role: preRegistered.role,\n        team_id: preRegistered.team_id,\n      })\n      .eq(\"id\", user.id);\n\n    if (profileError) {\n      console.error(\"Failed to update profile:\", profileError);\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nepodařilo se aktualizovat profil\" },\n        { status: 500 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Claim the pre-registered email\n    await supabase\n      .from(\"pre_registered_emails\")\n      .update({\n        claimed_by: user.id,\n        claimed_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n      })\n      .eq(\"email\", school_email.toLowerCase());\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      success: true,\n      verified: true,\n\n}",

        "contents": "await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\n  })\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Middleware check\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n// User has active access, continue...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~40 lines SQL (users, profiles, indexes) |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~25 lines |\n\n| Server actions (auth logic) | Medium | ~60 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Medium | ~50 lines (includes DB queries) |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form + linking | Medium | ~120 lines |\n\n| Pending approval page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n| Access revoked page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~385 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Separation of Concerns\n\n### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)\n\n- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails\n- **Database**: Store profiles and users data (no RLS - Next.js handles access control)\n- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers, no functions\n\n### Next.js (All Business Logic)\n\n- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing\n- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation\n- **Validation**: Domain validation, input sanitization, business rules\n- **Authorization**: Role hierarchy checks, permission enforcement\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                         Next.js                                  │",

        "contents": "- Příklad: &#96;page.tsx&#96; je server, &#96;login-form.tsx&#96; je client\n\n#### 2. Supabase integrace\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Server component\nconst supabase = await createClient();\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n// Client component  \nconst supabase = createClient();\nawait supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 3. Fetch na API routes\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nconst response = await fetch(\"/api/verify/send-code\", {\n  method: \"POST\",\n  headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n  body: JSON.stringify({ school_email }),\n});\nconst data = await response.json();\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Existující databázové tabulky\n\n| Tabulka | Účel |\n|---------|------|\n| &#96;profiles&#96; | Rozšíření auth.users (jméno, role, tým, verified) |\n| &#96;teams&#96; | Týmové firmy (Viento, Tuuli, Aero) |\n| &#96;pre_registered_emails&#96; | Seznam povolených školních emailů |\n| &#96;verification_codes&#96; | Dočasné kódy pro ověření |\n\n### Existující role\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TYPE user_role AS ENUM ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Sidebar navigace (app-sidebar.tsx)\n\nUž existuje placeholder pro Rezervace:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n{\n  title: \"Rezervace\",\n  url: \"/dashboard/reservations\",\n  icon: CalendarDays,\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Otázky k diskusi\n\n### 1. Kdo může rezervovat?\n- [ ] Všichni ověření uživatelé?\n- [ ] Jen určité role?\n- [ ] Potřebuje se něco schvalovat?\n\n### 3. Jak dlouhé mohou být rezervace?\n- [ ] Minimální/maximální délka?\n- [ ] Celý den vs. časové sloty?\n- [ ] Opakující se rezervace?\n\n### 4. Co když jsou konflikty?\n- [ ] First-come-first-served?",

        "contents": "begin\n  v_raw_meta_data := new.raw_user_meta_data;\n  v_google_email := coalesce(new.email, v_raw_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'email');\n  v_google_full_name := v_raw_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'full_name';\n  v_google_profile_picture := coalesce(\n    v_raw_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'avatar_url',\n    v_raw_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'picture'\n  );\n  \n  insert into public.users (\n    auth_user_id,\n    google_email,\n    google_full_name,\n    google_profile_picture\n  )\n  values (\n    new.id,\n    v_google_email,\n    v_google_full_name,\n    v_google_profile_picture\n  )\n  on conflict (auth_user_id) do update set\n    google_email = coalesce(excluded.google_email, public.users.google_email),\n    google_full_name = coalesce(excluded.google_full_name, public.users.google_full_name),\n    google_profile_picture = coalesce(excluded.google_profile_picture, public.users.google_profile_picture);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.handle_new_auth_user() is 'Trigger function that automatically creates a row in public.users table when a new user is created in auth.users. Extracts Google OAuth profile data from auth.users.raw_user_meta_data.';\n\n-- Create validation trigger function for CZU email domain\n-- Ensures that email addresses being changed must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\ncreate or replace function public.validate_czu_email_domain_trigger()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_email text;\n  v_email_change text;\n  v_domain text;\nbegin\n  if tg_op != 'UPDATE' then\n    return NEW;\n  end if;",

        "contents": "## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions",
